metrics.file_name: Alleged Mastermind Behind Carbanak Crime Gang Arrested - Threatpost.pdf

data.context: The suspected leader behind the cyber crime group that targeted banks to rack up more than one billion Euros in damage over the past few years has been apprehended, according to the Spanish National Police.
'The magnitude of the losses is signi fi cant: the Cobalt malware alone allowed criminals to steal up to EUR 10 million per heist.'
The crime group would send out bank employees spear phishing emails, impersonating legitimate companies, which harbored a malicious attachment.

evidence.quote: would send out bank employees spear phishing emails

data.context: If the attachments were executed, the criminals would use their malware to remotely control the victims' machines, giving them access to the internal banking network and allowing them to infect servers controlling the ATMs.

evidence.quote: use their malware to remotely control

data.context: 'The criminal pro fi ts were also laundered via cryptocurrencies, by means of prepaid cards linked to the cryptocurrency wallets which were used to buy goods such as luxury cars and houses,' according to Europol.

evidence.quote: The criminal pro fi ts were also laundered via cryptocurrencies

data.context: The organized crime group has been business since 2013 but its malware has been continually evolving and growing more sophisticated over the years.

evidence.quote: has been continually evolving and growing more sophisticated over the years.

data.context: As recently as January 2017, Carbanak ramped up its activity to include a new host of targets - including hitting a number of organizations in the hospitality, restaurant and retail markets, as well as a new command and control strategy involving Google's cloud-based services like Google Forms and Google Sheets.

object.name: a number of organizations in the hospitality, restaurant and retail markets

evidence.quote: hitting a number of organizations in the hospitality, restaurant and retail markets

data.context: Vitali Kremez, senior intelligence analyst at Flashpoint, said the arrest was 'great news' in a tweet.

Vitali Kremez @VK_Intel · Follow Great news on the #CobaltGang/#Carbanak investigation: one key #cybercriminal was arrested in Spain; alleged to have sold the compromised stolen information from hotel and bank industries on underground communities.
The Carbanak criminal gang has been a thorn in the side of the security community for years.

object.name: been a thorn in the side of the security community for years

evidence.quote: The Carbanak criminal gang has been a thorn in the side of the security community for years.

data.context: In Jan. 2017, Carbanak moved from an almost exclusive focus on fi nancial services and switched targets to those within the hospitality, restaurant and retail markets.

object.name: those within the hospitality, restaurant and retail markets

evidence.quote: switched targets to those within the hospitality, restaurant and retail markets

data.context: The backdoor is used to send system information and execute malicious code that uploads data, steals credentials and initiates tasks such as screen recording, which was a hallmark of Carbanak.

evidence.quote: The backdoor is used to send system information
